ideas.pitch: An agentic compliance officer for financial operations that uses explicit BPMN workflows with mandatory human-in-the-loop checkpoints before executing high-stakes transactions.
ideas.title: GuardRail BPMN: Autonomous Compliance Enforcer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core judging criteria of failure modes, human oversight, intervention, and reversibility, which are heavily weighted by the governance experts on the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An IT support agent for remote monitoring and management that takes destructive actions on customer machines while automatically generating instant system restore points and dry-run diffs.
ideas.title: RollbackAgent: Automated Undo for Enterprise RMM
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by demonstrating flawless 'reversibility'—allowing a human to instantly roll back agent mistakes with a single click, addressing the exact failure scenarios judges are looking for.

ideas.pitch: A semantic gateway proxy that sits between customer-facing AI agents and external APIs, intercepting anomalous tool-calls using a self-improving kNN exemplar index before execution occurs.
ideas.title: CircuitBreaker AI: Real-Time Hallucination Interception
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the training-free semantic routing architecture that won the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon, proving high technical execution in managing agent failure modes.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol server aggregator for clinical workflows that requires multi-party human sign-off on sensitive patient data writes and flags confidence drops in real time.
ideas.title: Clinical Guard: MCP-Orchestrated Medical Agent Oversight
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-utility real-world domain focus (healthcare) with rigorous oversight mechanics, scoring high on usefulness to real people and intervention quality.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that monitors exiting software engineers' terminal commands and PRs to construct interactive runbooks, preventing critical tribal knowledge loss.
ideas.title: DevOffboard: Engineering Knowledge Capture Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an acute, relatable pain point for technical judges and student organisers, following the winning pattern of targeting problems the judges feel themselves.
